title: The Yearbook of Lake Minnow
author: Juniper Yarrow
blurb: Kestrel Zhou, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
